# Secure Boot / UEFI Certificate Posture

Intune-first monitoring workbook for 2023 UEFI certificate readiness.

parameters.name: workspaceName
parameters.label: Workspace (optional)
parameters.query: IntuneSecureBootInventory_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) | extend WorkspaceName=tostring(split(tostring(_ResourceId), '/', 8)) | where isnotempty(WorkspaceName) | summarize by WorkspaceName | order by WorkspaceName asc

parameters.name: department
parameters.label: Department
parameters.query: IntuneSecureBootInventory_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d) | extend Department=tostring(coalesce(Department_s, OrgUnit_s)) | where isnotempty(Department) | summarize by Department | order by Department asc

content.query:
let osBuildBaseline = '{osBuildBaseline}';
let Classified = materialize(
IntuneSecureBootInventory_CL
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| extend WorkspaceName=tostring(split(tostring(_ResourceId), '/', 8))
| extend Department=tostring(coalesce(Department_s, OrgUnit_s))
| where '{workspaceName}' == '*' or WorkspaceName == '{workspaceName}'
| where '{department}' == '*' or Department == '{department}'
| extend DeviceId=tostring(coalesce(DeviceId_g, DeviceId_s, AadDeviceId_g, ManagedDeviceId_s))
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| extend DeviceName=tostring(coalesce(DeviceName_s, DeviceHostname_s, DeviceDisplayName_s)), BIOSVersion=tostring(coalesce(BIOSVersion_s, FirmwareVersion_s)), RequiredBIOSVersion=tostring(coalesce(RequiredBIOSVersion_s, BIOSBaseline_s)), BootMode=tostring(coalesce(BootMode_s, FirmwareType_s)), TPMVersion=tostring(coalesce(TPMVersion_s, TpmVersion_s)), UEFICertificateVersion=tostring(coalesce(UEFICertificateVersion_s, SecureBootCertVersion_s, CertVersion_s)), SecureBootEnabled=tobool(coalesce(SecureBootEnabled_b, SecureBootState_b, SecureBootEnabled_s)), IsExempt=tobool(coalesce(IsExempt_b, Exempt_b, IsException_b)), OSBuild=tostring(coalesce(OSBuild_s, Build_s))
| extend BootMode=case(BootMode =~ 'UEFI','UEFI',BootMode =~ 'Legacy','Legacy','Unknown'), TPMVersion=case(TPMVersion has '2.0','2.0',TPMVersion has '1.2','1.2',TPMVersion =~ 'None','None','Unknown'), UEFICertificateVersion=case(UEFICertificateVersion contains '2023','2023',UEFICertificateVersion contains '2011','2011',isempty(UEFICertificateVersion),'Unknown',UEFICertificateVersion)
| extend CertStatus=case(UEFICertificateVersion=='2023','Updated',UEFICertificateVersion=='2011','NotUpdated','Unknown'), BlockReason=case(CertStatus!='NotUpdated','None',BootMode!='UEFI','LegacyMode',SecureBootEnabled!=true,'SecureBootDisabled',TPMVersion!='2.0','TPMBelow2',isnotempty(BIOSVersion) and isnotempty(RequiredBIOSVersion) and BIOSVersion < RequiredBIOSVersion,'FirmwareBelowBaseline',OSBuild < osBuildBaseline,'OSMissingUpdate','None'), PostureState=case(IsExempt==true,'Exempt',isempty(DeviceName) or BootMode=='Unknown' or TPMVersion=='Unknown' or CertStatus=='Unknown' or isempty(OSBuild),'Unknown',CertStatus=='Updated','Updated',CertStatus=='NotUpdated' and BlockReason!='None','Blocked',CertStatus=='NotUpdated','NotUpdated','Unknown')
);
Classified
| summarize Devices=count() by PostureState
| order by Devices desc

| extend Department=tostring(coalesce(Department_s, OrgUnit_s))
| where '{workspaceName}' == '*' or WorkspaceName == '{workspaceName}'
| where '{department}' == '*' or Department == '{department}'
| extend DeviceId=tostring(coalesce(DeviceId_g, DeviceId_s, AadDeviceId_g, ManagedDeviceId_s))
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| extend DeviceName=tostring(coalesce(DeviceName_s, DeviceHostname_s, DeviceDisplayName_s)), PrimaryUser=tostring(coalesce(PrimaryUser_s, UserPrincipalName_s, AssignedUser_s)), Department=tostring(coalesce(Department_s, OrgUnit_s)), Model=tostring(coalesce(Model_s, HardwareModel_s)), BIOSVersion=tostring(coalesce(BIOSVersion_s, FirmwareVersion_s)), RequiredBIOSVersion=tostring(coalesce(RequiredBIOSVersion_s, BIOSBaseline_s)), OSBuild=tostring(coalesce(OSBuild_s, Build_s)), BootMode=tostring(coalesce(BootMode_s, FirmwareType_s)), TPMVersion=tostring(coalesce(TPMVersion_s, TpmVersion_s)), UEFICertificateVersion=tostring(coalesce(UEFICertificateVersion_s, SecureBootCertVersion_s, CertVersion_s)), SecureBootEnabled=tobool(coalesce(SecureBootEnabled_b, SecureBootState_b, SecureBootEnabled_s)), IsExempt=tobool(coalesce(IsExempt_b, Exempt_b, IsException_b)), LastSeen=todatetime(coalesce(LastSeen_t, LastSeen_s, LastCheckIn_t, LastSync_t))
| extend BootMode=case(BootMode =~ 'UEFI','UEFI',BootMode =~ 'Legacy','Legacy','Unknown'), TPMVersion=case(TPMVersion has '2.0','2.0',TPMVersion has '1.2','1.2',TPMVersion =~ 'None','None','Unknown'), UEFICertificateVersion=case(UEFICertificateVersion contains '2023','2023',UEFICertificateVersion contains '2011','2011',isempty(UEFICertificateVersion),'Unknown',UEFICertificateVersion)
| extend CertStatus=case(UEFICertificateVersion=='2023','Updated',UEFICertificateVersion=='2011','NotUpdated','Unknown'), BlockReason=case(CertStatus!='NotUpdated','None',BootMode!='UEFI','LegacyMode',SecureBootEnabled!=true,'SecureBootDisabled',TPMVersion!='2.0','TPMBelow2',isnotempty(BIOSVersion) and isnotempty(RequiredBIOSVersion) and BIOSVersion < RequiredBIOSVersion,'FirmwareBelowBaseline',OSBuild < osBuildBaseline,'OSMissingUpdate','None'), PostureState=case(IsExempt==true,'Exempt',isempty(DeviceName) or BootMode=='Unknown' or TPMVersion=='Unknown' or CertStatus=='Unknown' or isempty(OSBuild),'Unknown',CertStatus=='Updated','Updated',CertStatus=='NotUpdated' and BlockReason!='None','Blocked',CertStatus=='NotUpdated','NotUpdated','Unknown')
);
Classified
| where PostureState in ('Blocked','NotUpdated','Unknown')
| project DeviceName, DeviceId, PrimaryUser, Department, Model, BIOSVersion, BootMode, SecureBootEnabled, TPMVersion, UEFICertificateVersion, PostureState, BlockReason, OSBuild, LastSeen
| order by PostureState asc, BlockReason asc, DeviceName asc
